## Fixed

- **Other mods' fluids showed a magenta "missing texture" block in the Liquid Tank.** The tank
  guessed each fluid's texture by name, which only worked for water, lava, and Hydrofarm's own
  fluids. Any other mod's fluid — for example the experience fluid a Sophisticated Backpacks pump
  puts into a tank — drew as the pink-and-black error block. The tank now asks each fluid for its
  actual registered texture, so **any** fluid it can hold renders correctly.

## Added

- **Liquid XP now works together with Sophisticated Backpacks' experience fluid** (and any mod that
  follows the common `#c:experience` convention at the same 20 mB-per-point rate):
  - **Their XP flows into yours.** Experience pumped into a Hydrofarm tank now *merges* into your
    Liquid XP instead of being rejected as a different fluid — two mods' XP become one pool — and it
    can feed a **Mending Station**.
  - **Your XP flows back out.** Hydrofarm's Liquid XP is now recognised as experience, so a backpack
    can pump it in and its XP pump can cash it back to your own XP bar.
  - Conversion is exact (1 mB in = 1 mB out, no XP lost or gained) and only ever touches experience
    fluids — water, milk, lava, and every other fluid are completely unaffected.

## Notes

- Same changes as v0.2.7 on the Minecraft 26.1.2 line.
